observations: Blue painted industrial gear reducer with a flanged input and a yellow-painted output shaft.
The unit is mounted on a blue cast iron base plate with four mounting holes.
The housing features a ribbed design and a lifting eye at the top.
Watermark 'IFABROS INDUSTRIAL POSTED ON JIJI' is visible on all photos.
The output shaft appears to be a hexagonal drive shaft.
No brand name, model number, or technical specifications are visible on the unit itself.
